result.instructions: Tools for e-Boekhouden, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are still unpaid, and how much is outstanding in total?"; "Show the invoices we sent to Acme Ltd this year."; "What is the balance of each ledger account right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes e-Boekhouden data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eboekhouden_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eboekhouden_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eboekhouden_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. eboekhouden_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_relations
tools.title: List or search relations
tools.description: List relations (customers and suppliers of the administration), optionally filtered (filters combine with AND). Text filters match exactly unless match is contains or starts_with. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/relation.

match.description: How the text filters match: exact (default), contains or starts_with (case-insensitive wildcard match; % and ? in the text are wildcards).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_relation
tools.title: Get a relation
tools.description: One relation with all its fields (addresses, e-mail addresses, VAT and KvK number, IBAN, payment term, ledger). GET /v1/relation/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_invoices
tools.title: List or search invoices
tools.description: Search the invoices created in the invoicing module, by invoice number, relation or date (exact, or from/to). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/invoice.

match.description: How the text filters match: exact (default), contains or starts_with (case-insensitive wildcard match; % and ? in the text are wildcards).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One invoice with its items, amounts and relation. GET /v1/invoice/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_outstanding_invoices
tools.title: List outstanding invoices
tools.description: Open (unpaid) invoices: debtors (D, sales invoices customers still owe) or creditors (C, purchase invoices still to be paid). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/mutation/invoice/outstanding.

kind.description: D = debtors (customers owing you), C = creditors (suppliers you still owe).

match.description: How the text filters match: exact (default), contains or starts_with (case-insensitive wildcard match; % and ? in the text are wildcards).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_mutations
tools.title: List or search mutations (bookings)
tools.description: Search the bookkeeping mutations: type 1 invoice received, 2 invoice sent, 3 invoice payment received, 4 invoice payment sent, 5 money received, 6 money sent, 7 general journal entry. Filter by type, mutation number, description, invoice number or date. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/mutation.

type.description: Mutation type 1-7 (1 invoice received, 2 invoice sent, 3 payment received, 4 payment sent, 5 money received, 6 money sent, 7 journal entry).

match.description: How the text filters match: exact (default), contains or starts_with (case-insensitive wildcard match; % and ? in the text are wildcards).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_mutation
tools.title: Get a mutation (booking)
tools.description: One mutation with its rows (ledger, VAT code, amount, relation, invoice number). GET /v1/mutation/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_ledgers
tools.title: List ledgers (chart of accounts)
tools.description: The ledger accounts (grootboekrekeningen): id, code, description and category (BAL balance, VW profit and loss, FIN, DEB, CRED, AF6, AF19, AFOVERIG, VOOR, BTWRC, AF). Use the id as ledger_id in other tools. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/ledger.

category.description: Category, e.g. BAL, VW, FIN, DEB, CRED.

match.description: How the text filters match: exact (default), contains or starts_with (case-insensitive wildcard match; % and ? in the text are wildcards).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_ledger
tools.title: Get a ledger
tools.description: One ledger account. GET /v1/ledger/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_ledger_balance
tools.title: Get a ledger's balance
tools.description: The balance of one ledger, optionally per cost center and for a period (from/to). GET /v1/ledger/{id}/balance.

cost_center_id.description: Only mutations of this cost center.

from.description: Balance over the period starting at this date (the difference), instead of the actual balance.

to.description: The balance at this date, inclusive (default today).

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_ledger_balances
tools.title: List all ledger balances
tools.description: The balances of all ledgers (a trial balance), optionally per cost center and for a period (from/to). GET /v1/ledger/balances.

cost_center_id.description: Only mutations of this cost center.

from.description: Balance over the period starting at this date (the difference), instead of the actual balance.

to.description: The balance at this date, inclusive (default today).

tools.name: eboekhouden_create_relation
tools.title: Create a relation
tools.description: Create a new relation (customer or supplier) in the administration. Only name is required; the code is generated when omitted. Returns the new id and code. POST /v1/relation.

code.description: Relation code (max 15; generated when empty on create).

gender.description: m = male, v = female, a = department.

email_address_reminder.description: Address payment reminders are sent to.

company_registration_number.description: Chamber of Commerce (KvK) number; digits only.

ledger_id.description: Ledger id of this relation (from eboekhouden_list_ledgers).

tools.name: eboekhouden_update_relation
tools.title: Update a relation
tools.description: Change fields of an existing relation. The tool first reads the relation, then sends its current values with your changes on top (the API requires name on every update), so fields you do not pass keep their values. This overwrites the current values of the fields you pass. GET + PATCH /v1/relation/{id}.

code.description: Relation code (max 15; generated when empty on create).

gender.description: m = male, v = female, a = department.

email_address_reminder.description: Address payment reminders are sent to.

company_registration_number.description: Chamber of Commerce (KvK) number; digits only.

ledger_id.description: Ledger id of this relation (from eboekhouden_list_ledgers).

inactive.description: Mark the relation inactive (true) or active (false).

tools.name: eboekhouden_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product or service. Needs code, description, a sale VAT code and a ledger id, and exactly one of price_excl or price_incl. Returns the new id. POST /v1/product.

vat.description: Sale VAT code of the account's country, e.g. HOOG_VERK_21, LAAG_VERK_9, BE_21_VERK or GEEN (purchase codes are refused by the API).

tools.name: eboekhouden_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create a sales invoice for a relation. PERMANENT: the API cannot change or delete invoices afterwards, and an invoice number is used up. The invoice is created only: it is NOT e-mailed to the customer, NOT booked as a mutation and no direct debit is set. Needs relation_id, template_id (eboekhouden_list_invoice_templates), term_of_payment in days and at least one item with a ledger_id. Returns the new id and invoice number. POST /v1/invoice.

price_per_unit.description: Price per unit: excluding VAT when in_ex_vat is EX (default), including VAT when IN.

vat_code.description: VAT code of the account's country. NL sale: HOOG_VERK_21 (21%), LAAG_VERK_9 (9%), VERL_VERK (reverse charge), BU_EU_VERK, BI_EU_VERK, AFST_VERK, AFW_VERK (divergent, needs vat_amount). BE sale: BE_21_VERK, BE_12_VERK, BE_6_VERK, BE_0_VERK, BE_IC_VERK, BE_EXP_VERK. GEEN = no VAT.

vat_amount.description: VAT amount of the item; only with vat_code AFW_VERK.

product_id.description: An existing product id (from eboekhouden_list_products); then code is ignored.

discount_amount.description: Fixed discount on price_per_unit (not with discount_percentage).

invoice_number.description: Invoice number; must end with a number. Generated when omitted.

in_ex_vat.description: Whether price_per_unit includes (IN) or excludes (EX) VAT.
